subject: Possible co-list on a Westlake home
body:
Hi Rich,

I have a client with a beautiful 4/3 in Westlake Hills who is considering selling this fall. They want a commercial-minded perspective because of the lot size, but it is still very much a residential listing. Would you be open to co-listing or referring someone from your team?

The home needs light cosmetic work, but the views are outstanding and I think we could position it around $2.4M. Happy to send photos and the prior survey.

Best,
Megan Holloway
REALTOR®, Keller Williams Realty
512-555-0186
TREC #712944

subject: Rates moved - investors are locking again
body:
Rich,

Quick market note for your investor database: we are seeing a meaningful pickup in jumbo and DSCR locks after this week's rate move. Park Capital can pre-qualify buyers in 24 hours and has non-QM options for self-employed borrowers.

If you have any listings where financing uncertainty is slowing offers, I would be glad to run scenarios for your clients. We also offer a referral partnership with monthly co-branded rate updates.

Regards,
Elliot Park
Senior Loan Officer | Park Capital Mortgage
512-555-0144 | NMLS 1842097
Reply STOP to unsubscribe

subject: Off-market 61 acres | Delaware, OH | utility-served
body:
Rich,

Reaching out cold because your land-bank model may fit a situation we are handling north of Columbus. Ownership will entertain a direct process on 61 acres at US-42 and Cheshire Road in Delaware County. Water and sanitary are adjacent; the current comprehensive plan supports mixed residential.

They are not ready to publish an OM, but would consider a group that can underwrite entitlement risk and close without a retail listing process. Guidance is $68,000 per acre.

If Ohio is worth a look, I can send the survey and utility correspondence under a simple NDA.

Connor Blake
Executive Vice President | Colliers
614-555-0191
Ohio Salesperson License #2019004567

subject: Turn every listing into 40 buyer conversations
body:
Hi Rich,

ListLift automatically turns your property listings into targeted LinkedIn and email campaigns for local buyers, investors, and agents. Teams using us average 40 new conversations per listing in the first month, without adding a coordinator.

We noticed KW Commercial Austin has strong inventory but limited retargeting activity. I recorded a two-minute audit showing exactly where we could add leads to your pipeline.

Are you open to a 15-minute walkthrough Tuesday or Wednesday?

Tara Singh
Growth Partnerships, ListLift
Book time: listlift.io/tara
Unsubscribe here

subject: Kyle entitlement - 12.3 ac, FM 1626 frontage
body:
Rich,

I have a quiet assignment that is probably relevant to your group. The site is 12.3 acres at 18401 FM 1626, Kyle, immediately east of IH-35. Seller completed the rezoning and has an approved concept for 156 garden-style units; water/wastewater are to the boundary and the detention study is done.

They are asking $2.10M and would prefer a 45-day diligence period. This is not broadly marketed yet. I can forward the civil set, title commitment, and zoning ordinance if you have interest.

Rafael Morales
First Vice President | CBRE
512-555-0129 | TREC #650118

subject: Vacant-property staging before your next sale
body:
Hello Rich,

Staged Right Austin helps agents and owners sell vacant homes faster with rental furniture, light refreshes, and photo-day styling. We have openings next week and can stage a standard home in 48 hours.

We work on commission-sensitive budgets and offer partner pricing to Keller Williams agents. If you have a seller preparing for photos, I would love to quote it.

Thank you,
Brooke Raines
Owner, Staged Right Austin
512-555-0171
stagedrightaustin.com

subject: Newark redevelopment assemblage - preliminary outreach
body:
Rich,

We are advising a family on a three-parcel assemblage near Broad Street in Newark, New Jersey. There is an older 18,000 SF office building on one tract, but the value proposition is redevelopment: roughly 2.1 acres, transit-adjacent, with a prior mixed-use concept that was never advanced.

The family is testing interest before deciding whether to list. They understand a buyer will need to rework the approvals and environmental diligence. Let me know if you want a first look at the package.

Derek Wallace
Managing Director | JLL Capital Markets
973-555-0138

subject: Sublease: 8,420 SF at 500 W 2nd
body:
Hi Rich,

A venture-backed tenant is offering its furnished 8,420 SF office suite at 500 W 2nd Street for sublease through March 2030. The suite has 11 offices, large boardroom, all furniture in place, and downtown views. Asking rent is below direct market and the landlord is open to an extension.

Given your tech background, I thought there may be a portfolio company or operator in your orbit that needs a turnkey Austin HQ. Floor plan and tour times are attached.

Lisa Nguyen
Director, Office Leasing | Cushman & Wakefield
512-555-0164

subject: 38 ac off SH 130 - owner will talk before listing
body:
Rich -

Got a landowner I know near the 130/45 corridor who asked me to call a few groups before I put anything in the market. It is 38.06 acres on the east side of SH 130, about a mile south of FM 2001, Hays County. Flat ground, ag exempt, no FEMA floodplain on the preliminary map.

Water line is across the frontage and wastewater is being studied with the district. Seller is indicating high $40s per acre, but there is room if you can move cleanly. No broker opinion or OM yet.

Want the pin and survey?

Wade Kincaid
Broker/Owner | Texas Ranch Sales
512-555-0108 | TREC #493801

subject: Confidential: 184-unit Austin multifamily opportunity
body:
Rich,

We have been retained on a confidential sale of a 184-unit, 1990s-vintage multifamily community in North Austin. The property is 94% occupied, has substantial loss-to-lease, and offers an achievable renovation program. The seller is seeking north of $31M.

I realize this is not a land offering, but your fund may know a capital partner interested in a value-add basis with future density optionality. An executed CA is required before we can release the address, T-12, and rent roll.

Alyssa Bennett
Senior Associate | Marcus & Millichap
512-555-0159

subject: Bastrop County 220 ac - quick temperature check
body:
Hey Rich,

Before I circulate this, would your land bank take a run at 220 acres near the SH 71/County Road 109 area in Bastrop County? It is contiguous, currently in ag, and ownership has not signed a listing agreement. There is meaningful creek/floodplain in the back third, but the upland lays well and power runs along 109.

Seller's family is talking mid-$30s an acre. They are not sophisticated and will care about certainty more than squeezing every dollar. I have an old survey and a rough flood exhibit.

Chris Harlow
Land Advisor | DHJ Land & Ranch
512-555-0116
TREC #598327

subject: Rochester, MN development land | 27.8 acres
body:
Mr. Gary,

Newmark has been engaged to market 27.8 acres south of Rochester, Minnesota, near the Mayo Clinic's expanding employment corridor. The property is guided for medium-density residential and municipal utilities are available at the site.

The ownership group is seeking proposals rather than a fixed asking price and would welcome a buyer that can navigate a planned-unit-development approval. We are beginning a controlled callout this week and can make the OM available upon request.

Sincerely,
Nora Feldman
Senior Managing Director | Newmark
612-555-0188

subject: Miami-Dade infill site | 3.4 ac | Quiet process
body:
Rich,

A local owner asked us to identify two or three credible land buyers for a 3.4-acre infill tract at 11800 SW 216th Street in Miami-Dade. The parcel is vacant, outside the flood hazard area on the current panel, and has water/sewer in the road. Current designation supports a residential entitlement path; preliminary density work is in the file.

The owner is quoting $6.8M, subject to terms, and does not want signage or a public campaign. We can provide survey, title, and the planner's memo after an NDA.

Jorge Alvarez
Executive Managing Director | Colliers South Florida
305-555-0121 | FL Lic. SL3319420

subject: Commercial roof inspections for your clients
body:
Hi Rich,

Sunset Roof Co. is offering free roof inspections and storm-damage documentation for commercial property owners across Central Texas. We can also help owners maximize insurance proceeds and schedule repairs around tenant operations.

If any of your sellers need a proposal before putting a building on the market, send us an address and we will prioritize it. We pay a referral fee on completed work where permitted.

Paige Monroe
Business Development | Sunset Roof Co.
512-555-0197
Roofing Contractor Registration #TX-88421

subject: NNN medical clinic, Round Rock - 6.1% cap
body:
Rich,

Please see the attached teaser for a newly built, single-tenant medical clinic in Round Rock. The asset has 11.4 years remaining on an absolute NNN lease to a regional orthopedic group, with 2% annual bumps and a personal guaranty. Asking price is $8.45M, representing a 6.1% cap rate.

The underlying parcel is 1.7 acres, though this is being marketed strictly as a stabilized income investment. Let me know if you or a 1031 buyer would like the full package.

Grant Ellison
Managing Director | Northmarq
214-555-0112

subject: Portland industrial land callout - 14 acres
body:
Hi Rich,

We are conducting a limited outreach for a 14-acre industrial land site near Airport Way in Portland, Oregon. The site has freeway access, most utilities at the property line, and flexible employment-industrial zoning. Ownership is looking for a buyer willing to take on some wetland mitigation.

I saw several of your recent land transactions and thought the entitlement angle might be relevant, despite the different geography. If you have Pacific Northwest interest, I can share the environmental and land-use materials.

Hannah Price
Senior Vice President | CBRE
503-555-0173

subject: Oklahoma City fringe land - likely outside your box?
body:
Rich,

I know Oklahoma may be just outside your preferred geography, but this one has the kind of basis you usually look for. It is 96 acres southeast of Norman, on a future arterial, with a preliminary plat concept for 310 lots. Water is close but sewer extension is the real work.

The landowner wants a capable buyer rather than a national auction process. We have not set a formal price, though he has been hearing roughly $22k per acre from local groups. Worth a conversation, or should I keep you to Texas and Florida?

Markus Stein
Principal | Longhorn Land Co.
405-555-0168

subject: Buyer inquiry: your East Austin tract
body:
Rich,

I represent a regional townhome developer that came across your East Austin land listing near Springdale. They have a live pipeline gap for 2027 deliveries and would like to understand whether the site is still available and whether you would consider a controlled two-week diligence period.

Their preference is to acquire an entitled or near-entitled parcel and close without financing contingency. If the tract is spoken for, they would also welcome similar 5-20 acre opportunities inside the Austin growth corridor.

Denise Carroll
Senior Vice President | JLL
512-555-0133

subject: Referral opportunity: relocating family
body:
Hi Rich,

I have a relocating family looking for a four-bedroom home in Lakeway or Bee Cave, ideally under $1.8M, and I wanted to see if you work with any residential buyers or would like to receive referrals. They are pre-approved and expect to tour next weekend.

I am also happy to send you homeowner leads considering a sale. My clients frequently ask for commercial referrals when they are evaluating an investment property.

Best,
Samira Patel
REALTOR® | Austin Home Finders
512-555-0182
TREC #782104

subject: Operating self-storage portfolio - Tampa / Orlando
body:
Rich,

Avison Young is selectively marketing a three-property, climate-controlled self-storage portfolio in Tampa and Orlando. Combined physical occupancy is 89%, with roughly 142,000 net rentable square feet and an experienced third-party manager in place.

There may be upside through revenue management and small expansion pads, but this is principally an operating-business acquisition. Ownership is targeting $24.5M for the portfolio. Let me know if you have an investor looking for Florida operating real estate.

Todd McElroy
Principal | Avison Young
813-555-0141

subject: Council action: South Austin PUD amendment approved
body:
Rich,

Flagging a land-use item that may matter to you. Austin City Council approved the PUD amendment last night for the former nursery tract at 9300 S Congress Avenue. The amendment increases permitted residential intensity and cleans up the access/parkland language that had been holding the site back.

The owner is not our client, but we represented an adjacent stakeholder and understand they are now evaluating a sale versus self-development. I can send the ordinance number and staff backup if you want to assess whether it is a real shovel-ready opportunity.

Kelsey Rowan, AICP
Principal | Cobb Tanner Planning
512-555-0178

subject: Boston suburban hotel redevelopment site
body:
Rich,

A lender is preparing to sell a closed 142-key hotel in the Route 128 corridor outside Boston. The improvement is obsolete, and several buyers are underwriting the 5.6-acre parcel as a residential or life-science redevelopment play. Existing zoning is imperfect, so the highest value requires a local entitlement strategy.

We are gathering indications before a formal sale process. It struck me as the type of basis-versus-entitlement situation your platform understands, although Massachusetts is likely not a target market for you.

Erin Walsh
Vice Chairman | CBRE Capital Markets
617-555-0103
